from.place: Proof paragraph 2, derived coefficient-adjunction and inverse-limit calculation; foundational ordinary Quillen counit criterion used in pinched rigidification. An equivalence left adjoint has invertible counit.

title: An equivalence left adjoint has invertible counit
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories in the sense of [def-nagata-category]. Let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be functors with an adjunction $h:L\dashv R$, meaning natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(LX,Y)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(X,RY)$. Its counit $\epsilon_Y:LRY\to Y$ is the map corresponding to $1_{RY}$. If $L$ is an equivalence of categories (it has a functorial quasi-inverse and natural isomorphisms of both composites with the respective identity functors), the counit $\epsilon:L\circ R\Rightarrow\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal D}$ is a natural isomorphism.
